name: Download Fox
source: user-provided ChatGPT-generated character stills (6 views), no accompanying ad-concept or human pairing this time
archived_copy: gAIstreich-comfy-agent/assets/downloadthat_ad_chatgpt_refs/ (full source folder, 26 files, copied there per Benjamin's explicit instruction)
provenance_note: Same treatment as ad07's Puzzle Dog: stills are externally sourced, not local ComfyUI inference; all video motion (I2V) is 100% local LTX-2.3. See DECISIONS.md ADR-017.

design.outfit: black sleeveless vest, coral-to-teal gradient download-arrow logo on chest
design.distinguishing_texture: hexagon/honeycomb pattern on tail (fox's equivalent of Puzzle Dog's jigsaw seams)
design.personality: energetic, confident, fast-talking, direct-to-camera hype-mascot energy -- contrasts Puzzle Dog's dry deadpan

reference_views.mascot_3quarter_smirk.png: 3/4 angle, hand on hip, confident smirk
reference_views.mascot_phone_pose.png: full body holding phone showing app UI, pointing at it
reference_views.mascot_profile_talking.png: 3/4 profile, mouth open as if talking/gesturing
reference_views.mascot_fullbody_gesture.png: full body, one hand raised, neon stage backdrop

not_used_as_separate_crops: All six source images were already clean single-character compositions at 941x1672 -- used directly as storyboard/i2v source frames without additional cropping, unlike ad07's turnaround-sheet source which required manual crop boxes.
relationship_to_other_mascots: Fifth campaign concept, not a replacement for Puzzle Dog (ad07) or any earlier concept. Both mascots remain valid, separate creative directions per ADR-017.
